description: Get the Swiss Consumer Price Index (CPI/LIK), which tracks cost of living including residential rents. Baseline December 1982 = 100. Published monthly by BFS. For property purchase prices, use get_property_price_index instead.

limit.description: Number of recent monthly data points to return (1–60, default 24). Ignored if year is set.

year.description: Filter to a specific year (1983–2025). Omit for latest 24 months.

name: get_rent_index
